meta.note: Prompts reference specific Baklava components and props by name, as an experienced Baklava developer would. expectedComponents are the correct real bl-* tags.

prompts.prompt: Create a login form: two bl-input fields (type="email" and type="password", both required with labels) inside a <form>, and a bl-button type="submit" variant="primary" as the submit action.
Build a settings screen with bl-switch toggles for each option and a bl-select (with bl-select-option children) for the language, using the help-text attribute on each field.

Build a product listing with bl-table and a bl-table-header / bl-table-body. Use bl-table-row and bl-table-cell, add a bl-button action per row, bl-pagination at the bottom, and a bl-badge on popular rows.
A destructive confirmation using bl-dialog (open, caption, critical) that blocks the background, with primary kind="danger" and secondary bl-button actions for confirm/cancel.
Show a saved-confirmation with bl-notification containing a bl-notification-card, and a dismiss/action bl-button. The card should be dismissible.
Group several bl-accordion elements inside a bl-accordion-group for an FAQ section where each question expands its answer.
Add a bl-stepper with three bl-stepper-item steps (cart, shipping, payment) marking the current one active, plus a bl-badge over a cart icon displaying 2.
Use bl-tab-group with bl-tab and matching bl-tab-panel for switching views, and add a bl-tooltip on a small icon bl-button.
